verdicts.reason: A and B look pixel-identical, so the result is a tie. Both share the same flaws. The top of the skates is cropped, so the hanging laces from the original are lost. The 'ICE RINK' headline has shrunk and sits off to the right, where it barely outranks the skate art. The arrow is jammed into the 'USE CODE' / 'TO GET A DISCOUNT' row, and the promo copy and divider are squeezed into tiny, hard-to-read text. Decorative circles are cut off at the canvas edges.
